title: People
model_roles_hint: Grants say who can access which project
about_1: Everyone in {org}, and where they work: the projects each person can access, with their role, and the ones they were seen active in. The matrix shows the same for everyone at once.
about_2: Invite a person to add them to the organization; put them on specific projects from a project's Team tab.
legend_active_tenant: active in — tenant access lets everyone into every project, so only where somebody was seen working is shown
legend_about_access: Can access is the access config: role grants on a project or on the whole organization. Under tenant access every member can access every project.
legend_about_active: Active in is what was seen: open pull requests authored or reviewed, the project's Activity feed over the last {feed} days, desktops open on it, and Insight's pull requests and reviews over the last {insight} days in the project's repositories. Git activity counts only for a git account the person claimed or confirmed on their Profile.
stack_tenant_none: can access all {count} · no activity seen
stack_of_title: Under tenant access everyone can access every project
matrix_empty_title: No projects in this organization yet.
matrix_empty_body: People are placed on projects once there are some.
panel_no_activity: No activity seen in any project.
more_access: …and can access {count} more without activity seen.
insight_about: Pull requests authored and reviews given, from Constructor Insight's warehouse, for the git accounts this person claimed or confirmed. Repositories no project here holds still count toward the totals.
no_handle_body: Pull requests and reviews count once the person claims their git account on their Profile (Identities).
no_handle_unreadable: Their accounts could not be read: that takes the people.view permission.
recent_no_handle: Nothing attributed: no git account linked.
metrics_later: Trends per person arrive with the organization's metrics panels.
invite_hint: They see the invitation when they sign in with this address, and become a member when they accept it. Put them on projects from each project's Team tab.
invited: Invited {email}. They join when they sign in with that address and accept.
